notes.title: Playtest 0.26
notes.content:
Mode selection screen
 Daily run screen - with leaderboards, historical view, etc.
 Should have fixed steam cloud errors.. ?
 Made master broth common
 Logs now stored in logs folder
 Screenshots now stored in screenshots folder (F2/ F3)
 Full Map Screenshot (F3) now includes goblins
 Fixed bug where jungle wasnt in daily map pool

notes.title: Playtest 0.25
notes.content:
Added unique bosses for each map
 Adjusted rarities and chances in the shop to hopefully make it more fun/useful
 Added Quiver relic
 Changed some guilds
 Adjusted endless mode scaling to be exponential instead of polynomial
 Slower curve used for sappers and witches
 Hopefully reduced amount of non viable runs in random mode
 Nerfed goblin ear for endless
 Chanterelle is now +1 damage for each nearby tree

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.24
notes.content:
Added full map screenshot feature available from pause menu / F3  
 Reduced the price of some items in the shop  
 Balanced random run to have less nonviable starts

notes.title: Playtest 0.23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Features

 Added mode selection screen, random run  
 Added drag build, enjoy improved QoL in endless and otherwise  


Content

 Added dirt wand, ice wand, toxic waste for painting tile types  


Changes

 Seed pods moved to rare  


Bug Fixes

 Fixes to do with hatchet and pickaxe not making enough gold

notes.title: Playtest 0.21
notes.content:
Core Changes

 Added ability to buy relic slots.
 Introduced Victory Medals.
 Added visual effects for losing life.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed garden shed incorrectly counting as a path.
 Fixed bug where tombstone seeds would change unexpectedly.


Maps

 Jungle: Added pygmy goblins, goblin chiefs. Removed treasure goblins.
 Wasteland: Added hotrod goblins.
 Adjusted bikers and cars to have increased speed on roads.
 Updated waves for Desert and Wasteland.
 Updated crop mutation mechanics, removed crop death in Wasteland.


Relic Changes

 Emerald, Crystal Flute: Attack speed reduced.
 Hatchet, Pickaxe: Now target nearby entities.
 Tactics Manual: Now counts different unlocked gnome types.
 Property Deed: Buffed — now grants +1 damage for every adjacent house.


New Relics

 Plow
 Blood Whip
 Mirror

notes.title: Playtest 0.19
notes.content:
System Changes/Polish

 Increased speed of tick rate from 0.5 seconds to 0.34 seconds, making 1x speed viable again.
 New item frames corresponding to rarity added.
 Options for gnome warning (exclamation marks) and space night hotkey added.
 Progress should now migrate from demo/playtest versions.


New Map

 Tundra


Changes to Existing Maps

 Zombies' speed nerfed.
 Skeletons' speed and armor nerfed.
 'Crypt' added to graveyard generation.
 Graveyard grass added.


Balancing

 Some item prices adjusted.


New Items

 Wheel of Fortune
 Treasure Map
 Beehive
 Seed Pods

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.18 - Introducing Graveyard
notes.content:
System Changes

Relics are now limited to 10 slots
Items can be banished from build bar and relic slots
Rarity system added - Common, Uncommon, Rare determining shop appearance frequency
Healing is uncapped


Balance

Rebalanced many shop prices
Lion's mane now gives 50% XP per mushroom
Fruit basket / Fishing hook now give 2 gold


New Upgrades

Gnome Statue
Cotton
Daisies
Huckleberries
Tavern
Corn
Magic Beans
Bodhi Tree
Hatchet
Pickaxe
Prayer Beads


Changed Maps

Wild Cactus added to desert
Some waves changed on swamp, desert to increase QoL


New Maps

Graveyard map added with necromancer & zombie goblins


Polish

Main menu screen now responds to biome
F2 Take Screenshot key
Tooltips added to level screen

Reworked end of run screens

notes.title: Playtest Version 0.12
notes.content:
Shop now only shows 3 items
 Adjusted waves on forest
 Upgrades now prioritized by longest time since seeing rather than completely random

 Armor reworked into block chance rather than flat damage reduction
 Price reductions on bamboo, lantana, manure and pumpkin in the shop

notes.title: Patch Notes for Playtest 0.11
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0.11

Balance

 Desert waves adjusted
 Kingsguard nerfed to 10hp
 Armour nerfed to 5hp
 Slowed Kingsguard
 Reduced road bonus
 Spear attack speed nerfed
 Wheat nerf - 6g to build
 Made some prices cheaper: pumpkin, manure
 Starting gold increased
 Sunflower nerf - 3g to build
 Added item limit to build bar - 10 items
 Shop now stocks 4 items


Content

 Blood Chalice - gain $2 when losing life
 Bone Chimes - gain $2 when using banish
 Wedding Ring - for cluster of 2 gnomes, their attack cooldown resets the other one's cooldown


Polish

 Defeat screen juiced
 Added screen shake
 Goblin King HP bar added


Features

 Speed control buttons during night
 Idle gnome button
 Center camera button
 Moved undo button and put shop where it was

notes.title: 0.10 Changelist
notes.content:
Systems

Introduced the shop, replacing the upgrade system with a cash shop

Balance

Much balance affected by the addition of shop
Sunflowers nerfed to 3g cost, cheap to buy at shop
Sawmill nerfed to 8
Cactus cheaper to build
Coffee now stacks

Content

Added Garlic, the crop that reduces nearby enemy armour
Added Peppers, the crop that gives nearby gnomes +%10 crit chance
Stingray Barb, crits deal 300% damage
Goblin Ear: +5% crit and +1g from crit kill
Fruit Basket: Gnomes +$1/day when adjacent to trees

Other

Polished menus
Polished sounds
New sounds introduced
Gnome name generation added

notes.title: 0.9 Playtest
notes.content:
New features:
Added damage numbers
Added critical strike
Added left-shift to fast forward time (proper button for it is coming)

Changed Upgrades:
Rusty shiv now gives crit chance instead of +1 damage
nerfed trowel to only affect crops (now excluding bamboo and lantana but actually still affects hedge)

New Upgrades:
- Sleeping Potion (double flail stun duration)
- Morel (gnomes +1 pop use, +1 damage)
- Chanterelle (gnomes +1 damage when next to tree)
- deathcap (2x goblins spawned)
- gold top (gnomes 50% xp gain, -1 pop use)
- wolf head (gnomes +1 damage when alone)
- wolf heart (gnomes +10% crit when alone)
- wolf claw (gnomes -20% cooldown when alone)
- gumboots (gnomes can go on swamp tiles)
- palantir (wizard +1 range)
- lotus (spreading swamp crop)

Bug fixes:
fix continue after dying bug
fix flickering red X
Lazy pathing bug fixed when goblins would cut through big mazes

Other changes:
revised some tooltips
changed desert sapper distribution
added wishlist buttons
added discord entry to main menu
changed idle gnome warning to be red
increased stun fatiguing, increased stun duration

notes.title: Playtest 0.7
notes.content:
Economy Overhaul
 Beans now produce fertile soil at the end of a day
 Change level up to allow you to hide and view map
 Gnomes and Goblin tents got UI and SFX updates
 Idle Gnomes are now more clearly highlighted.
 Dynamite no longer works with recycling bin
 Hose can now destroy bamboo, leaving behind swamp
 Pumpkins could be planted on regular tiles, they can now only be planted on or moved to a fertile tile
